task_language: Pick the chocolate pudding and place it in the basket

localization.pudding: Agentview_high RGB label identified the small brown Chocolate Pudding box right of the orange juice and left of basket; agentview back-project samples included [-0.1091,0.0788,0.0178], with edge samples rejected/treated as noisy. Wrist after pre-position centered the same labeled box under the gripper.
localization.basket: Agentview_high identified the woven basket with white liner on robot-left/image-right; region back-project over the visible liner/rim gave cavity band around y=0.25-0.29, then wrist confirmed the box was over the open liner before release.

pudding_pi0_pick_step2.visual_confirmation: wrist_high showed the chocolate pudding box raised between the gripper fingers

strategy_notes: Localized the chocolate pudding from readable agentview_high label and confirmed geometry with the wrist. Step 1 moved above the pudding anchor at [-0.11, 0.08, 0.18] with open gripper. Step 2 used pi0_pick prompt "pick up the chocolate pudding" with max_chunks=12, lift_thresh=0.05, gripper_closed_thresh=0.06; wrist and gripper width confirmed a held box. Step 3 carried closed to [-0.12, 0.16, 0.20]. Step 4 carried closed to [-0.08, 0.25, 0.20] over the basket. Step 5 nudged closed to [-0.045, 0.255, 0.20] to center over the liner. Step 6 released with max_steps=30; the pudding dropped inside the basket and terminated.
